extension.summary: Download themes and trailers for your library with yt-dlp
extension.description: Pick a movie or TV show from your Kodi library, search YouTube for its soundtrack (theme.mp3) or trailer (name-trailer.mp4), preview the results and download them straight into the title's folder. yt-dlp, ffmpeg and a JavaScript runtime can be installed and updated from the add-on settings.
extension.news: 1.0.5 - New icon, single context entry, faster searches (cache + parallel), audio preview for themes
